reaction: The distinction between moving ions and the travelling message was interesting.

effect: The prepared fibres joined the supplied receiving cells, completing the nervous tissue and the chapter.
reaction: The finished tissue brought the two projects together as expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the ion channels was most worthwhile: the sequence showed how an electrical change travels without one ion travelling the whole fibre.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding blood vessels was clear but less interesting; the result mostly confirmed the expected supply of food and oxygen.

surprise.text: I was surprised that neighbouring channels open in turn rather than a single ion carrying the message the whole way.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The final pairing followed the goal, though it was the only offered combination.

continue.text: I would choose to continue, because the channel sequence made me curious about how nerve messages work beyond the fibre.
